input.summary: Add TrueLink IP/misconduct indemnity with defence procedure and limit Client's indemnity to Client Content and Client's violations of law.
input.comment: [Playbook] TrueLink's indemnity currently reaches only its own breach of this Agreement, so we added a defence and indemnity for third-party IP infringement, TrueLink's breach of applicable law, TrueLink-caused data breach and its gross negligence or wilful misconduct, with a standard notice/control/cooperation procedure. We also limited our indemnity to Client Content and Client's violations of law, consistent with our playbook position.

ops.text: TrueLink shall defend and indemnify Client and its affiliates against any third-party claim to the extent arising out of (i) an allegation that the Interface, Hosting Services or Support Services infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right, (ii) TrueLink's breach of applicable law, (iii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Client Content or other Client data caused by TrueLink, or (iv) TrueLink's gross negligence or willful misconduct. Client shall promptly notify TrueLink of any such claim, TrueLink shall have control of the defense and settlement of the claim, and Client shall provide reasonable cooperation in the defense.

ops.oldText: (i) any claim arising out of any breach by Client of this Agreement, (ii) any claim or demand resulting from any act or omission by Client or any customer of Client granted access to the Interface by Client which constitutes a breach of or default by TrueLink under any System Agreement or Credit Repository Agreement, which breach or default has either not been cured or cannot be cured within the applicable cure period and the consequences of which is that TrueLink will lose material rights it has pursuant to said Agreements or a violation of any state or federal law, rule or regulation (iii) any claim arising out of or relating to the Web Site or Client Content (including, but not limited to, any claim resulting from any content posted to the Web Site by Client or Client's employees, agent or any customer of Client granted access to the Interface by Client), without regard to any knowledge limitation or qualification that may be contained in this Agreement, and (iv) injury or damage to person or property caused by a product, service, or information, whether or not defective, that is sold, distributed or transmitted from the Web Site.
ops.newText: (i) any claim arising out of or relating to Client Content, and (ii) any violation of any state or federal law, rule or regulation by Client.
